gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-cascadia-mono: A splayed c terminal gives Tilt Neon its loudest tell, tubes of constant width with a big lowercase. Cascadia Mono follows in sans-serif, its letters standing like pins in a wide board, compact and uniform.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa spreads wide, clean curves that stay distinct, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. And Tektur does the showier job, bending pipe-cleaner strokes into outsized lowercase that Lexend Exa never attempts.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-lexend-exa: Bold is the first word for Tilt Neon, whose tube-like strokes and splayed c terminals demand attention. Lexend Exa then takes over the quieter work, keeping its wide curves distinct and its sans letters easy to tell apart.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-merriweather-sans: Ancient brush dabs, set far apart, with no stroke variation. Merriweather Sans is the sturdy counterweight, its tall lowercase and clearly opened e making sans-serif words look large and readable beside Nordic's cramped, carved heaviness.
gen-gf-wallpoet-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips apart and its mean line high. Wallpoet earns its keep when set big and short, its stencil-cut letters leaving paper showing between them.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-supreme: Unica One's very large lowercase eye leaves daylight inside every curve, with no hairlines and no swells anywhere. Unica One announces; Supreme, a crisp sans, holds the text steady underneath.
gen-gf-warnes-satoshi: Ink strokes that taper out before touching, spaced wide with zero contrast, make Warnes unmistakable. Satoshi brings the approachable counterpoint, a plain sans whose soaring x-height and open e never look squeezed.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code reads as wire-thin monoline sans-serif, with neighbors spaced so far apart you can't ignore them. Unica One's big round lowercase sits above it comfortably.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono sets compact sans-serif letters like pins in a wide board, with curves as thick as the stems. Unica One's open, single-thickness curves lead it with confidence.
gen-irish-grover-manrope: Irish Grover brings tall, sturdy lowercase and open-throated letters with a soft step from heavy to light strokes. Manrope tidies up beneath it, a sans-serif with bright curve openings and arches matching the stems.
